key_findings: Large-scale commercialization is not sufficient for Gold.
Exact patent-to-product mapping is not sufficient for Gold.
Patent-level attribution remained unresolved in all 10 matched pairs from public T0 evidence.
Evidence traceability is the most frequently observed public difference but is confounded by disclosure regime.
Telecom, software infrastructure and foundational AI show strong observability ceilings.
V0.6 is useful for readiness/evidence diagnosis but is not supported as a stable Gold-vs-Silver predictor.
next_step: formalize V0.7 architecture proposal and validate on 24th edition without altering 25th results
